title: Geothermal siting on tribal lands and HUBZones - Sustainability 2025 paper code
description:
The calculations behind Jones, Munjurpet Sridharan, Aghapour and Rodriguez (2025), Sustainability 17(6), 2558: power per repurposed oil and gas well from an R134a organic Rankine cycle (CoolProp), and enhanced-geothermal capacity and facility counts by temperature class across U.S. tribal lands and HUBZones.

python scripts/run_all.py reproduces the paper's Tables 4 and 5 exactly, and the "This Study" column of Table 2, in seconds with no solver or licence. The GIS suitability analysis behind Table 3 was done in ArcGIS and is not re-run; its per-class results are included as data, held identical to the printed table by a test, and the layers are published separately.

Code is MIT-licensed; the data and result tables are CC BY 4.0. The README records three known issues in the published tables, none of which changes a conclusion.
